action_inputs.description: When true, after writing each A record the action polls the CloudBolt appliance's own resolver until the record resolves to the registered IP, retrying on the ldap_dns DNS_RESOLUTION_POLL_SECS interval up to DNS_RESOLUTION_TIMEOUT_SECS (defaults: every 10s, up to 15 min). A record that never becomes resolvable within the timeout fails the action for that server. When false (default), the action returns as soon as the record is written.
action_inputs.label: Wait for DNS Resolution
action_inputs.name: wait_for_resolution

description: Creates an AD-integrated DNS A record for each provisioned server over LDAPS and records its identity for teardown.
name: AD DNS - Create A Record
